items.title: Terri Lyne Carrington interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing himself as Monk Rowe. The interviewee responds with 'Hello.' There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship beyond the interviewer-interviewee dynamic.

ctx.x: Terri was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 9, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Terri Lyne Carrington with me this morning.
